visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Inner Class Created Without an Outer Instance
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The program does not compile: main is static and creates the inner class without an enclosing Main object.

solution.explanation: An inner class instance is tied to an instance of the outer class, because it can read the outer fields. From a static method there is no current outer object, so you must say which one: m.new Wallet().
